Name: Fartdew Valley
Author: VvampMods
Description:
[size=5][b]Fartdew Valley[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]About[/b][/size]
This mod allows you to fart using a simple keybind.
I made it as a way to teach myself how to make mods for this game, hence its simple nature.

You can configure the mod using GMCM.
The default fart key is 'delete'.

[b]Planned Features[/b]
- Multiple different sound effects
[s]- 'charged' fart [/s][b] Implemented in 1.1.0! [/b]
- NPC reactions 
- (maybe) skills, like a fart blasting away grass behind you, if your skill level is high enough
